name: Sam Altman
subtitle: AGI & AI Strategy
bio: Sam Altman is the LLM Strategist for the Statistics Programming Club. As the CEO of OpenAI, he is at the forefront of the global transition toward Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). His work focuses on the intersection of large-scale compute, massive datasets, and the societal implications of highly capable autonomous agents.

timeline.description:
Leading OpenAI in the pursuit of safe and beneficial AGI.
Directing massive-scale research and deployment of models like GPT-4.
